findings.summary: The copy is not made durable, and file modes are not preserved. The backup files are written with os.WriteFile 0o600 and never synced. The returned directory therefore reads as a whole copy, but a crash or power loss right after BackUp returns and before the rewrites could leave truncated backups. Original page modes are not recorded, so a restore by plain copy resets permissions.
evidence: copyInto uses os.WriteFile with no File.Sync and no directory sync before BackUp returns success.
applyMigration starts rewriting pages immediately after BackUp returns, so the backup is the only rollback.
The restore test writes with a fixed 0o644 mode and compares only content, not modes.

findings.summary: The test gaps are narrow. The collision test only checks the second backup (the -2 suffix). The partial-cleanup test covers only a missing page, not a failed MkdirAll or WriteFile mid-copy. The RemoveAll-failure branch that joins the two errors is untested.
evidence: TestVaultBackup_TwoBackupsAtOneInstantDoNotCollide makes two backups at one fixed instant and never a third.
TestVaultBackup_AFailedCopyLeavesNoPartialDirectory triggers failure only through a nonexistent page.
No test covers the errors.Join path in BackUp.
I read vaultBackup (BackUp, newDirectory, copyInto) in cmd_migrate_card_pages.go.
Collision handling is sound. os.Mkdir is exclusive, so each call owns its directory. The timestamp name and the -N suffix names cannot overlap, and an existing directory is never merged into.

Cleanup is safe. RemoveAll targets only the directory this call just created with Mkdir, so it cannot delete an earlier backup or vault content. A failed copy therefore leaves no partial directory that could be mistaken for a whole one.
The precedence sidecar is skipped only when it does not exist. Every other read error aborts the backup before any write.
Ordering in applyMigration in internal/promote/migrate_cards.go: BackUp is called once, before the first Store.Set or WritePage. A backup failure returns 'nothing was written'. This satisfies S6 (c).

I read migrate_card_pages_backup_test.go. It covers same-instant collision, no partial directory after a failed copy with a retry, and a restore round trip that returns the vault to its original bytes.
I did not run the tests. They were not run.
